notes.title: Patch Notes 21st March 2019
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/ac790325070dbe245aaade3401cb20ae648cffa5.jpg
About this patch
We are very happy that we came to an agreement with Jagex so we now have control over the game. We look forward to working with the games awesome community to ensure that  the servers are up, and matches can be found.

One of the things we want to do, is to try out things (sometimes quite radical stuff). Some of these you will hate, and sometimes for good reason. We will be listening to you, and looking at the data, and when it turns out that some things do not work we will  try to be quick remove or resolve it.

Our key focus for this update was trying to reduce the time needed to search for matches. We have also added some new blocks that we hope will shake up how the matches are played. We have also done a much needed balancing pass, and some tweaks and fixes that we know you have been waiting for. We look forward to hearing what you guys think. Building is awesome.


Toadman Crate
A little welcome from us for all existing players.
The crate will either contain a random new character, or if you have all characters, a random new skin. If you have all characters and skins, your crate will contain 3000g
(This crate does not include special exclusive skins)

New Blocks
Cloud: The Cloud block has to be built next to another block, but will remain up in the air if the blocks around it are destroyed, giving a new perspective for the “sky bridges”
Cannon: Fire a bullet at a fixed time, which does damage on explosion
Piggy Bank: The Piggy Bank device block gathers bricks over time. When destroyed, the contents of the piggy bank are shared among the team.

Characters max level
The character max level has been increased to 200. At level 125 and 150, you will receive 1500 Gold. At level 150 and 200, you will received bounty crates (Gold at 150 and Diamond at 200)

Character Balancing
Reduced Sweet Science’s Gravity Well duration by 30%
Reduced Sweet Science’s active ability cooldown from 60 to 55 seconds
Reduced Sweet Science’s Gravity Block lifetime from 10 to 8
Reduced Sweet Science’s build range from 4 to 3
Reduced Sweet Science’s Gravitron Stance Arc by 33%
Increased OP Juan Shinobi’s teleport cooldown by 50%
Reduced OP Juan  Shinobi’s teleport pool by 15%
Increased Vander’s Static Gloves damage by 20%
Reduced Vander’s Ball Lightning attack time by 20%
Removed Astarella’s Rocket Boots knockback effect 
Reduced Astarella’s Saucer Launcher clip from 5 to 4
Reduced Astarella’s Saucer Launcher world damage by 20%
Increased Astarella’s Saucer ammo pool from 36 to 40
Reduced Trondson’s active ability cooldown from 60 to 50 seconds
Increased Trondson’s active ability duration from 10 to 12 seconds
Increased Trondson’s Kobold Lamp ammo pool by one
Increased Cogwheel’s speed by 10%
Increased Cogwheel’s Cannon ammo pool by 25%
Increased Yuri’s snowball critical damage by 15%
Reduced Dream Genie’s build time by 20%
Reduced Dream Genie’s active ability cooldown from 60 to 50 seconds
Reduced Dream Genie’s Ifrit Grudge reload time by 25%
Increased Roly Poly Booster Rocket distance from 4.5 to 5

Blocks
Reduced Cost Build of Forcegate
Reduced Cost Time of Forcegate
Reduced Durability of Forcegate

Perks
Scaled all negative effects with tier levels
Buffed some positive effects (Toe, Ball, Heel, Knee; Breadwinner; Dig That Ammo; Health Scavenger; Quick Fingers, Fatmobile, Fire Lamps...)
“Toe, Ball, Heel, Knee” negative effect switched from Movement Speed Reduction to Health Pool Reduction
Removed movement speed reduction from Roly Poly’s Fatmobile

Economy
Increased general Gold rewards by 300%, including challenges, daily connections and matches
Increased Dust rewards by 300%, including bounty crates and challenges
Increased the free bounty crate rate from 1 per day to 1 every 5 hours
Increased probability for bounty crate drop after a match
Remove Foam block, Bush Thorn block and Nuke block from the Bounty Crates
Increased block skins drop rate in Bounty Crates

Match
Reduced the build time to 90 seconds
Changed the matchmaking from 5v5 to 4v4. Primarily to make sure that the matchmaker works better for lower playerbase, but also to mix things up to give a new take on the game. Custom matches will still support 5v5.
4 new maps. Smaller maps with only one objective. The maps will be easier to navigate and get an overview of.
Only maps with 1 cube will be the available maps for matchmaking. Custom games will still be able to select from any map
Squad size has been increased to 4 from three
Reduced the AFK timer to 2 minutes warning, and 3 minutes to remove from the match
Reduced the lobby timer to 60 seconds from 120 seconds

Mode
Removed Time Assault

UI and HUD
In the shop, unified how the button acts for Heros, Skins and Blocks

Bug Fixes
Thorn bush, if a player is inside they can still shoot out, BUT, now if you shoot back, you will deal damage to both block and player inside. This fix also applies to Mud and Forcegate blocks.
Re-added the missing  “buy Hero” button in the shop
In the shop menu each block of the selected hero didn’t have stat icons. Also, those stats are now shown correctly.
While browsing a hero’s profile from the Heroes tab, tab becomes unselected while viewing
Fixed daily Challenges for Spawn block and Large Bomb quantity
OP Juan Shinobi Katana reload time back to 1s.


Other
To comply with GDPR regulations there will be an information box for you to accept for us to be able to collect and save your data. This will show only once on your first login after this patch.

notes.title: A block to the future - news update
notes.notes:
Hey Blockheads,

It’s been a while since we last posted and promised we’d let you know what’s happening to Block N Load – apologies for staying silent for so long and thanks for being patient.

However, the long wait is now over and here’s the great news: We're happy to announce that the future development of Block N Load has been taken on by its co-developer, Artplant, now a part of Toadman Interactive!
 
The team at Toadman is super passionate about the game so it’s very fitting that they will take full control of Block N Load. This means they’ll control everything from the day-to-day management of the servers right through to exciting new content updates, as well as look after you all. We have no doubt that Artplant and its parent company Toadman are best placed to drive Block N Load into a brand new and successful future, after all, their experience and knowledge of the game is second to none!

“Toadman Interactive and Jagex both wanted to focus on ensuring Block N Load fans of today and tomorrow continue to see the investment and evolution of this great game, so we’re thrilled to reach an agreement that means we can bring the game in house,” said Robin Flodin, CEO of Toadman Interactive. “The original development team at Artplant are cooking up some great new updates for the game, which they will reveal soon.”

Phil Mansell, CEO, Jagex said, “This deal is great news for the Block N Load community and fans of team-based shooters, as it bolsters this innovative game with further investment and creative ambition. We saw in Toadman Interactive a kindred spirit who share our passion for live games and community-driven development. It’s a real positive for Block N Load players that Toadman and Artplant are taking the game’s production and operations forward, and we’re confident they have the vision and share the community’s appetite to give Block N Load a great future.”
 
But why the radio silence since our previous post? Well, we wanted to ensure we did everything possible to secure the long-term future of the game for all of you, which meant during the discussions with Toadman, anything stated publicly could have affected the outcome of the negotiation – and we just couldn’t risk that from happening.
 
We hope you’re as happy as we are with today’s news - see you on the battlefield, Blockheads!

- The Block N Load Team

notes.title: Block N Load – Mini-Patch
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/e4226d6d5294e571a306ef7c2a4f08e5b698d9a0.jpg

Hi all, 

We’re bringing a small update to Block N Load to fix a handful of the issues that you have reported to us. 

We’re still hard at work on a whole host of other improvements and other fixes that you’ve asked for since our December update, some of which we’re hoping to get out in another update in February. 

Fixes 
Based on the reports that you’ve made since our last update went live we have been able to fix a number of issues, we’re still hard at work to get some of the more complex ones resolved. 

However, as of today you should find that the following issues are now resolved. 
Perks 
Yury the Yeti’s Perk “Chill, Dude” should now work correctly with Ice as well as Snow. 
Vander Graaf’s “Ball to the Wall” Perk should now alter the Ball Lightning weapon. 
Kira-chan’s “Thrills for Days” Perk no longer incorrectly alters the damage mechanics for the Katty Launcher. 
Trondson’s “Fire Lamps” Perk has been updated to make it clearer this adds the “Burning” effect. 
Doc Eliza’s “It’s Alive! Alive!” Perk has been updated to make it clearer how this affects her healing. 

Blocks and Block Skins 
Poison Bush now correctly counts as a Building Blocks for the Daily Challenges. 
Gift Wrapped Large Bomb Block Skin no longer has its name in all upper case. 
The following Blocks should now use their correct names when awarding Dust from Bounty Blocks: 
Tunnelling Torpedo 
Orbital Strike Beacon 
Bounce Pad 
Bricks 
Speed Block 
Marid's Boon 
Miasma Mine 
Lil' Buddy 
Ninja Shrine 
Tiki Head 
Popstar Portal 
Kreepy in the Box 
Ammo Crate 
Large Bomb description has been updated, as there’s now a more powerful bomb than it. 

Hero Tips 
Vander Graaf’s Hero tips have had a typographical error corrected. 
Trondson has had a small number of initial Hero tips added. Got more tips you think would be good for players new to Trondson? Leave us a suggestion! 

Balancing 
Block Buster 
Only tools will do damage to the Block Buster. 
Tools now do the same amount of damage to the Block Buster as they do to objectives. 
Block Buster hit points have been reduced to off-set the lower rate at which damage is dealt to it. 
Effectively, the Block Buster is now treated like an objective for dealing damage to it and releasing the Boost. 

This one’s a pretty significant change. We’ve had this on the Player Test Realm for a little while, and based on the feedback there this change is at least an interesting one which seems to have some support to see what it does in the wider game. 

This does now mean that the abilities of Heroes will no longer have an effect on how quickly you can break in to the Block Buster, but neither will weapons or Devices. 

This helps address one issue which has been raised to us; that Trondson in particular was able to break in to the Block Buster far too quickly, but it may also help to make fights over who gets the Block Buster more of a key endeavour as well. 

Heroes 
Trondson 
Sonic Staff ammunition regeneration rate has been reduced from 20 to 15. 
Vander Graaf 
Lightning Cage Active Ability damage per second has been reduced from 2 every 0.1 seconds, to 2 every 0.15 seconds. 
Astarella 
Saucer Launcher clip size reduced from 6 to 5. 
Yury the Yeti 
Snowball clip size increased from 5 to 6. 
Tony Turetto 
Glue Gun slow against enemy Heroes doubled from 1 second to 2 seconds. 
Sweet Science 
Graviton Stance reload time slightly increased from 1.5 to 1.75 seconds. 

Recall Duration 
Time taken to return to your own spawn point after pushing the “B” key has been reduced from 15 to 10 seconds. 

Have any feedback? 
Post it in the Feedback section of the Steam Discussion forums here.

notes.title: EasyAntiCheat & Bug Fixes Galore
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/3900de865cb9596ed5b1b817ef2b879b5d039b00.jpg

The world-leading game security solution has arrived in Block N Load, helping make the game fair for all players. We’ve got a big batch of bug fixes too, for a smoother BnL experience than ever.

Block N Load is a fun place to build forts and blast your friends, but it also needs to be fair. Cheating is an issue that we take very seriously, and today’s update takes a huge step towards addressing it.

We’ve integrated EasyAntiCheat (EAC) into today’s Block N Load build: a proven, safe technology that’s formed part of many successful, competitive online games. It analyses both client- and server-side techniques, and smartly adds suspicious behaviour patterns to its database, preventing them from being used again.

Everyone will now be prompted to update to the latest version of Block N Load, which will install EAC. Please note that Block N Load will no longer run without EAC installed.

Bug Fixes
Here are the latest fixes to the game, also included in today’s update:
Aiming at the Block Buster Boost should no longer show the “do not attack” warning crosshair.
Block Buster Boost should no longer be layered behind the skybox. 
Devices should now only show their health as changing when they are actively taking damage, instead of the next time you look at them after they’ve taken damage while you’re elsewhere on the map.
Switching between Heroes on the ‘Your Heroes’ screen in the Profile section of the menus no longer causes RAM usage to continually increase.
Vander Graaf’s Tesla Coils can only be charged one at a time, instead of multiple with a single shot.
Objective (Base and Cube) hitboxes have been improved to better match the visuals of them.
Vander Graaf’s Tesla Coils no longer infinitely charge themselves when placed in specific arrangements.
Audio for Kira-chan’s Active Ability correctly stops when the final objective is destroyed.
Buffs granted by Heal Stations and Ammo Crates at the maximum map height are no longer retained after leaving the area of the Blocks.
The Hero you last played will now correctly be saved as the default for the next match.
Falling Blocks should no longer cancel building.
An exploit--where players could use perks and blocks from a different hero via a glitch on the profile page--has been fixed.
A non-functional stat section of the menus has been disabled.

Enjoy!

There’s more on the way very soon, so keep your eyes on the Block N Load news. Enjoy the game!

The Block N Load Team

notes.title: Community Arenas and Balancing Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/ed1c459684cd267e44f1c19cd243a879a3f643a7.png

The winning arenas from the "Midsummer Madness" map competition have been added as options in Custom matches.  The arenas "Blocky Resort", "Beach Bash", and "Cruise Boat" were all originally created by members of the Block N Load community.  

Additionally, a small number of balancing changes have been made at the same time.  For the full details of these please click to read more. 


Arenas
Beach Bash
Originally created by community member Alpha, Beach Bash is a three objective arena that scored highly in the Midsummer Madness map competition for the varied types of terrain in the map.  Now that it is being rolled out in to Custom matches you can try scaling the mountains as Astarella, climbing buildings as O.P., or making use of the cover to advance through the middle as Sarge.  

Blocky Resport
Created by △Triangle△ for the competition Blocky Resort seems to be a relatively simple two objective arena.  However, don't let that dissuade you from trying it out as there are quite a number of options for alternative routes to be dug or built to get from one end of the arena to the other.

Cruise Boat
Cruise Boat was one of the more strikingly unique arenas that was submitted to the Midsummer Madness competition and scored very highly for the originality shown.  Originally created by sanojLeOne, this three objective arena has a unique design to it which centers around the massive Cruise Ship.   


Balancing
After undergoing a period of testing on the Player Test Realm several changes have been made to a number of Blocks and Heroes.
 
Heroes
Sweet Science
-Primary Weapon (Blitz Stance)-
There have been a number of comments made that Blitz Stance's alternate "dash" type attach can be used much more effectively to quickly deal higher damage by using two short uncharged attacks than by charging the attack up.  This meant that there was little reason to attempt to use the charged attack against a player.  We've now made a few tweaks to the alternate attack to try and change this.
Uncharged dash attack damage against Heroes reduced from 20 to 15.
Charged dash attack damage against Heroes increased from 20 to 30.
Uncharged dash attack damage against Blocks reduced from 30 to 25.
Charged dash attack area of effect damage against Blocks reduced from 60 to 45.
Charged dash attack now has 10 direct damage to the Block that it in the centre of the area hit.

-Secondary Weapon (Graviton Stance)-
Sweet Science's Graviton Stance pull has become much more effective with the new reticules showing the area it will affect.  One of the reasons that arc for the alternate "pull" type attack was so wide was to make it easier to catch people.  With the reticule now making that easier the arc can be reduced a little.
Width of arc reduced from 132 to 120 degrees.

Vander Graaf
-Hero Block (Tesla Coils)-
Massed Tesla Coils have been proving a little bit too effective, and we've made a few slight tweaks to them as a result.
Damage to Heroes reduced from 19 to 17.
Self damage when firing increased from 9 to 10.
 
O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi
-Secondary Weapon (Ninja Stars)-
It was previously highlighted to us that Ninja Stars were behaving slightly differently depending on whether you have Bloody Bleeding equipped or not. 

We have now adjusted the timing so that throwing the Ninja Stars with Bloody Bleeding equipped results in the same timings as throwing them without the perk equipped. 

This should hopefully mean slightly less of a ‘pause’ after clicking to attack with the Ninja Stars, but doesn't alter the amount of damage that can be done with them.

 
Blocks
Towards the end of last year it was noted that some of the Blocks that can be placed instantly were in some cases out-performing similar Blocks and Devices which take time to construct. Of particular note amongst these were the wooden Crates, and the Caltrops. 

Crates
Cost of placing a Crate increased from 2 to 3.

Caltrops
Hit points reduced from 25 to 20.
Toughness (damage resistance) reduced from 4 to 3.

notes.title: Update 3.3 - Quitting Prevention & More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/c5e87b74c67034e66c4c0053ff483f46c16ae3a1.jpg

The latest update to Block N Load brings with it some new changes to the way leaving matches works, added the option to equip more than one badge on to your player card, as well as a new way of setting which Perks and Blocks you would like to use on a Hero before you enter into the queue for a match.

Change Hero Loadout Before a Match 
You can now set the Block, Skin, and Perk loadouts for your Heroes from the Profile menu instead of only being able to do so in the Hero selection screen when you are joining a match.

To change the loadout of a Hero:
Go to the “Your Heroes” section of the “Profile” page in the menus.	Select the Hero you would like to alter.
Select the Skin you would like to use.
Click on the “Edit” button below the Perks section and set the Perks you would like to use.
Click on the “Edit” button below the Blocks and set the Blocks you would like to use when playing this Hero.

notes.title: Update 3.2 - Lobby Improvements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/01f70b7abd9a2043b4efbaba0cc153ca4fe99bbc.png

Block N Load version 3.2 introduces improvements to the Hero Selection screen including an icon that indicates which Heroes are on free rotation, hover-tips for all weapons and abilities and a team composition warning.  This is along with a number of balancing changes, fixes to bugs and tweaks to improve other areas of the game. 


HERO SELECTION
 
The Hero Selection screen before you enter into a match has had a number of changes made to it to try and make it more obvious if your team may be fielding too many or too few Heroes that fill a particular role, how the different Heroes weapons and abilities function, as well as more information about the setup of your team-mates Heroes.  
Any Heroes that are on free rotation now have an icon displayed to indicate this.
Small icons for the Perks equipped on each Hero are now displayed below the Block loadout for that Hero (along with hover-tips if you move your mouse over them).
Hover-tips have been added when you move your mouse cursor over the images of the Blocks another Hero has equipped.
Hover-tips have also been added to your own Heroes weapons and ability icons displayed when you are selecting the Hero.
A message appears at the top of the screen if the team composition seems to be completely missing a Role, or if there are significantly more Heroes of one Role selected than either of the others. 
In Casual Mode the “thumbs up” voting icon on has been moved next to the number of votes to allow more of the arena’s preview image to be seen.
Icons to display which players are in squads have been added to Hero selection in a similar way to the in-game scoreboard.

BALANCING
 
A number of Heroes have had their weapons, abilities, and even some Perks tweaked and adjusted to set the Heroes more apart from each other.  Some Blocks have also been altered to try and make different loadouts more attractive.

Tony Turretto's Rivet Gun has been altered to try and make this shotgun-type weapon more vicious at close range, and less effective at very longer ranges.  Eliza's Miracle Cure is now more effective at healing and supporting her team, Kreepy the Klown's Bananas now explode quicker, Force Gates are now tougher, plus a range of other changes.

 
Click here to read the full patch notes.

notes.title: UPDATE 3.1 - Including Two Brand New Skins!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/0b720295ce4e8cde75d81a61502b93921e11b974.jpg

This update to comes with several improvements that are designed to make it easier to understand what is going on during a match as well as two new skins, a few bug fixes, and a slew of balancing changes to round out the new version.

Skins
Steam Science
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/7ebcfbbc663a354417260f93df3c534dc287b8b6.png
Sweet Science is a not-so-gentle gentleman inventor as well as a boxer.  Using arcane secrets of invention makes steam power the go-to force for taking down his enemies.

Roly Poly Dive Dive
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/f7fdf0e5e4f88eebbf6e7a7a1b95ccfddc4bbcce.png
A pressurised hamster ball for exploring the depths of the ocean which also works remarkably well on land as well.  Cannons for fending off the mightiest beasts of the sea are equally as effective against Heroes.  It’s probably best not to ask what powers the boosters.

Scoreboards – Viewing Squads
You will now be able to see which players are playing together in a squad.

When you bring up the scoreboard by pressing the “Tab” key during a match, or when you finish a game, you may find that there are small icons “I” or “II” in a circle next to some of the players.  These little icons display which players were in the first or the second squad on each team.

So, for example, if you were to see “I” next to three players on Team A, “I” next to two players on Team 1, and “II” next to another two players on Team 1 this would show that there was a squad of three people on Team A, and two squads of two people on Team 1.

Viewing Enemy Perks
If your Hero should be taken out by an enemy Hero then you will now see the Perks that Hero had equipped displayed whilst the kill cam is active.  This should hopefully start to give people a better idea of why the Hero that got them was moving quicker than expected or seemed to be shooting more accurately.

These will be displayed as icons at the bottom of the screen along with a short bit of information about the player and Hero.  Moving the mouse cursor over any of the Perk icons will display more information about the effects of that Perk.

New Reticules
Several Heroes have got some new reticules for their weapons.
O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi has a new reticule for his Katana which shows the approximate area of the swing.
Sweet Science has new reticules for his Blitz Stance showing the area of the punches, and for his Graviton Stance showing where its punch and pull will affect.
Kreepy the Klown’s Extendo Gloves now have a reticule which shows the area of his melee attack.

For the full patch notes click here.

notes.title: UPDATE 3.0 - Tesla + Communications Rework
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/74ebbd4dd943eab4e5ae2458e15d47b0cbfcba49.jpg

This update introduces significant changes to Vander Graaf's Tesla Coil Hero Block, plus and improved way of communicating with your teammates during a match.  Additionally, there have been plenty of balancing changes, which aim to make Heroes and Blocks more useful.


Tesla Coil Rework
Instead of using his Static Gloves to attack via the Tesla Coils, Vander Graaf now uses his Static Gloves to charge the Teslas.  

Tesla Coils can still form a network and pass the electrical charge from one to the next (as long as they’re in range of each other).  This means if you have four Tesla Coils built in a line, and the first one attacks (using its charge up to do so) the others can their pass their charge forwards to allow it to continue to attack.

This should give Vander a few more opportunities to move around the arena a little more whilst his Tesla Coils can at least launch some attacks whilst he’s not nearby.  However, he will need to return to them to recharge them once they’ve fired.


Messaging and Communications
By pressing the Left Alt key you can bring up a list of different messages you can send to your team.

When you send one of these messages it will display a short line of text to let your team know you 'need a Heal Station', or to 'defend your objective'. 

If you feel that there’s a message missing that would be useful for communicating with your team, then submit it here and we’ll see which ones we can get added to the game!


For the full patch notes click here.

notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7219617/21ef0ecb2cec9a1ed82bd22c7384021721607d1d.jpg

The latest version of Block N Load brings changes to the matchmaking system which should help improve the quality of matches plus additional options for Custom Games.  Of course, there are also a number of other improvements and fixes to go along with it as well.

Some of the key changes in this version include:

Custom Games
Custom Games have received some new functions to make them more interesting and easier to find players to join matches on player made maps from the Steam Workshop.

It is now possible to allow players to join a Custom Game even after it has been started, once a Custom Game has finished the host of the custom game can choose to take the game from the scoreboard back to the match setup screen, and new options to adjust the size of the Brick Wallet Cap along with the number of Bricks that each Hero starts the match with have been added.

Matchmaking
A number of changes have been made to the matchmaking systems to make them more flexible.  We’ve used existing data about the people currently playing Block N Load to set the starting points for these, and hopefully you should see some better matches formed as a result.


XP Boosters
It is now possible to purchase boosters that increase the amount of XP you gain from completing matches in the in-game Shop.  Each booster will run for the amount of time specified and during the time it is active will let you earn XP for your Heroes and Player Level faster.

4th of July Arena
Additionally, as this update is coming out on the 4th of July the arena "E Pluribus Unum" is making a return to Casual Mode rotation and Custom Games.

It's time to party like it's 1776!

notes.title: Yury in Rotation, Ranked Beta, and a Dev Update
notes.notes:
Free Rotation
Yury the Yeti replaces Cogwheel to join Vander Graaf and Nigel Purdey-Longshott in free rotation.  If you’ve not tried Yury this is your chance to find out how he plays.

Ranked Beta
The 6th week of the Ranked Beta allowed for any squad size and the requirements to have at least 3 level 10 Heroes available to select.  

Week 7 will feature squads of 5 only, however, with the new Squad Finder that was introduced in our latest update it should be far easier to find people to join your squads.  Don’t forget to set your Squad Finder preferences in the settings menu if you’re looking to join a squad!

We’ll also be creating a survey about how you found the different settings for the Ranked Beta.  However, you can always post your thoughts on the different Ranked Beta weekends in the “Feedback” section of the Steam discussion forum. 

Dev Progress
Let’s recap this year’s roadmap as it looks this week:
Separating Casual and Ranked - Done
Block Rebalance Pass 1 - Done
Progression Overhaul - Done
Squad Finder - Done
More arena voting options in Casual - Done (with some improvements to be made)
Hero Balance Passes – On-going alongside development work
Performance, Bug and Quality of Life fixes - This is always on-going
Improvements to the Tutorial - On-going
More cosmetic content - In Progress
More sales and short term events
-Bundle Support - In Progress
-Double XP weekends - Scheduled
-Free Hero weekends - Scheduled
-Flash sales - Scheduled
Custom game improvements - In Design
Reticule tweaks and improvements - In Design
In-game communication system improvements - In Design

We’re also working on some improvements to the Squad Finder based on player feedback,  some changes to the way matchmaking works, plus some new ways to spend Platinum and help support the game!

We have previously made mention of a few other features in past roadmaps, and while the following are still very much elements that are on our radar and we would like to improve on, we may find other features that could take precedence:
Seasonal (and other criteria) Ranked leaderboards
Ranked promotion/demotion systems
Clan System - Persistent clans or clan identification

The order of individual items on the roadmap can end up changing for a number of reasons, including the feedback that we have received.

•	Separate Ranked Beta mode.
•	New Hero progression rewards.
•	Changes to Roly and Tony's weapons.

Casual and Ranked Beta
Previously all players in Block N Load were entered in to one mode “Classic” which mixed together players who wanted a heavily competitive experience, and those who wanted to play without quite so much pressure. We’ve split Classic into two modes, both of which have their own set of rules, which we'll experiment with over the course of the Beta. We'll keep you posted as to any changes as we go.

Ranked will only be available at weekends initially. Check out the Play Screen Game Mode selector for dates and times in your region.

Gold Bar Rewards
Gold Bars awards now take in to account the length of the match, up to a cap.

Progression



We’ve made some quite significant changes to the Hero progression systems. Block Skins are back and you can get them by leveling up your heroes to 10 and 50 where you'll unlock block skins that can be used by any Hero that can take that Block into battle. We've also added more badges and titles for you to earn. 

Heroes
Roly Poly Fat Fat
Roly’s Booster system (her secondary weapon) and Hero Block have both had some significant changes made to them.

Booster Vent
Roly's secondary weapon's alt-fire now creates puddles of bubbling Toxic Goo trailing behind her. Use it to deny enemy access or help an escape.

Toxic Waste
When Roly’s Hero Block is detonated it too will coat the area around it with splodges of seething Toxic Goo.

Toxic Goo
Friendly goo is blue, while pink enemy Goo poisons and slows foes. Toxic Goo doesn’t hang around forever though - as enemy Heroes pass through it the Toxic Goo will be slowly used up, and eventually destroyed.

Tony Turretto
The way the shots from the Rivet Gun scatter has been changed.  Previously the pellets from the Rivet Gun would form tight clusters.  This often meant that you would either hit with all the pellets or you would miss all of them.  The pellets from the Rivet Gun now scatter more randomly within its cone of fire.

We’ve also been fixing some bugs and improving other areas of the game.

notes.title: Rotation Changes and an Update!
notes.notes:
We hope you’re enjoying the new progression, the new match awards and had a weekend full of ranked goodness with your friends! We’re not stopping there, of course, and today we’re bringing you an update on our Roadmap progress and what’s in the pipeline next. But first, let’s get a couple of announcements out of the way.

Hero Rotation and Time Assault
We’re changing to a Tuesday Rotation day so today we’re bringing Kreepy the Klown to our Free Rotation, joining Sarge and Eliza. This Dream Team gives you some extra oomph in your mid-field attacks where Kreepy can keep ‘em laughing with banana mayhem while Eliza makes those laughs their last. Meanwhile get Sarge pushing forward and take that base!

You'll also find the Time Assault is reset and Nigel’s “Raiders of the Lost Block” arena is ready to go.

Roadmap Update
Since the beginning of the year, we’ve been learning more and more about how players are playing the game both long and short term. We’ve also learned a lot about our workload capacity and we’re getting into a release pattern we can sustain. Over the last 3 months, we’ve done the following (along with numerous bug and quality of life fixes):

Separating Casual and Ranked - Done
Block Rebalance Pass 1 - Done
Progression Overhaul - Done
Hero Balance Passes – on-going (Hero Balance is something that we keep a constant eye on. We’re watching the balance of power as it shifts from hero to hero in response to new players and veteran players learning new tactics or changing up old ones.)
Performance fixes - On-going (We’ve made some small improvements and are continuing to investigate other ways to improve performance on various systems.)
New Tutorial/Hero Tutorials - In progress (We’ve added functionality to teach about the build phase barrier.  Supply and Blockbuster drops are on the way as we continue to refine the tutorial and we will be looking to add hero tutorials over time.)

Now we look forward to the summer and we’ve got a few other things on our immediate radar:

More sales and short term events - we’re looking at Bundles, Double XP weekends, Free Hero weekends and Flash sales as ways to get new and old players playing for longer and buying more.
More cosmetic content - we want to add more to buy and more rewards (yes, level 100 Block skins!). Again, we believe that having things to work towards really keeps people coming back, and of course, more things to sell helps our bottom line!
Bug and Quality of Life fixes - this is always on-going

As for our feature development work, we want to focus on key areas:

Encourage friendly and competitive team play and communication
Do as much as we can to help new players understand the depth and strategic elements of the game
Keep working towards better matchmaking at all levels

As a result, we’ve identified the following big features we’ll be working on. The order will depend on the full scope of the designs and other dependencies and we’ll update you on the particulars soon:

Squad finder – A way to find other players looking to join a squad before entering the queue to help find people to group up with before starting the match.
Matchmaking Improvements to include better squad matching
In-game communication improvements - Map ping system
Seasonal (and other criteria) Ranked leaderboards 
Ranked promotion/demotion systems
Clan System - Persistent clans or clan identification
Custom game improvements - Late joining, additional custom game options, etc

What do you think of these bigger features and which do you think are most important? We’d love to hear your feedback!

notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/steam_announcement_26-2.png

The next series of balancing changes has just arrived in Block N Load after feedback from players.  In addition to this, we’re also introducing a number of changes to arenas & refreshing the rotation!

The changes to the World Blocks, which make up the majority of most of our arenas, are some of the most wide-reaching that we’ve made in a balancing pass to date.  With these Blocks making up such a large part of the areas that the matches take place in even a small change can have a large impact.  With these changes you should find that it’s now easier to tunnel through some materials than others, and that damage from weapons affects the  Blocks that we’ve changed in different ways depending on the power of the weapon.

We’ve also tried to address some of the more common comments about balancing that we’ve seen – such as the timer on Astarella’s Orbital Strike Beacon Hero Block being too short to be able to reach it and defuse it – whilst making other changes around this to keep the blocks as balanced as possible when compared against each other.

notes.title: Update 2.5 - Kreepy the Klown
notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/steam-promo.jpg

Update 2.5 brings a new Hero to Block N Load as well as a whole host of improvements and changes.  

KREEPY THE KLOWN

Now available for all birthday parties and evil rituals, it’s Kreepy the Klown – Block N Load’s scariest Hero. This malevolent mischief-maker is now available to buy via the in-game shop. 

Kreepy comes armed to the teeth with boxing-glove Extendo Arms, explosive Trick Bananas and the most terrifying Hero Block to be added to the game to date.

Like every Hero, Kreepy also has some uniquely killer abilities. His giant Klown Shoes give him unnaturally high jumping skills and his active ability traps nearby enemies in a frightening maze of psychological spookiness (think Nigel’s Tiki Heads but with more evil clowns). From his dungarees to his fangs, Kreepy is 100% terrifying and 100% awesome.

If Kreepy sounds like the gig for you, head over to the in-game store and start spooking your opponents. Are you ready to give your foes nightmares?

Get him now!

> Introductory Hero Guide <

ARENAS
Sandy Shores has three objectives to take down in order to secure the victory. With wooden walkways, towers, mountains, and sandy beaches to scramble over when launching assaults, there are plenty routes to find and opportunities for forging your own path.

Beach Base has had a significant re-design to improve movement around the arena and allow for new attack routes, particularly when attempting to flank across the middle of the arena.

Additionally, all of the Arenas have been updated to accommodate multiple points for the BlockBuster Boost to appear at.  The BlockBuster Boost can now come in at any of these locations like Supply Drops.  This should allow more opportunities for different tactics for teams preparing for the BlockBuster Boost to drop in.

SUPPLY DROPS
Supply Drops are now twice as frequent as they were before, however, each individual Supply Drop is worth half of the value it previously had.  This means that you will have more opportunities to grab resources for your team.

BRICK WALLET CAP
The number of Bricks anyone can have as resources for building can now never exceed 5,000 at any time. 

During a match, the number of Bricks that your Hero currently has is displayed in the lower left.  Once 5,000 has been reached this number will begin to pulse red and you will be unable to gather more resources until you have spent some on building Blocks.

MORE CHANGES
Want to read more about the other changes that are in this update?  Check out the full update notes, and give us your thoughts on the Steam Discussion Forums!

The Block N Load Team

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Nigel Purdey-Longshot

Update 2.4 brings map mania to Block N Load. Top of the pile is the Map Editor which puts you in the seat of level designer. The update also brings a set of 4 fantastic new maps for classic mode, as well as a brand new Time Assault map themed around Sir Nigel Purdey-Longshott.

Work hard, play even harder with the Block N Load Map Editor. This brand new feature puts you in the seat of level designer. Create fully playable Block N Load arenas and invite the community to try them.
Experiment with tonnes of block and terrain types.
Build giant structures that can be battled over or admired.
Learn how to make a competitive map by strategically placing objectives like Cubes and Bases.
Set the mood with colour, texture and lighting options.

Shuko Style – this pagoda-filled arena has seen a lot of changes lately. Enjoy new attack routes and flanking opportunities from abundant water and greenery.

Up ‘N Over – a beginner-focussed arena with a large central bridge.

notes.title: Update - 2.3
notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/steam-promo.jpg

Update 2.3 is out NOW and brings big changes. A brand new single-player challenge mode is now live, called TIME ASSAULT. There are also big changes to the way bases take damage, and we’ve added profile stats data into the game!

SINGLE PLAYER MODE: TIME ASSAULT

Are you quick enough for Time Assault challenge mode? The goal is simple - get your Hero from one side of the map to the other. The faster you go, the better your score and reward. There are no rules - just get there any way you can. We can’t wait to see how you get there – so get recording and streaming and send us the links.

Base Damage Changes

We’ve changed the way the base cubes take damage! The ONLY WAY to damage a base now is with your melee (digging) tool. Weapons, bombs, rockets, grenades – they won’t work anymore. Cubes are now more fragile and a rechargeable shield has been introduced. A few melee hits on the shield will disable it, letting you chip away at the cube’s health. 



You can read the full details this update brings on the website and give us your thoughts on the Steam Discussion Forums!

The Block N Load Team

notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/kira_in_rotation_steam_promo.jpg

Sayonara, Nigel. Konnichiwa, Kira-chan.

Ladies and Gentleman, please welcome to the stage, Kira-Chan. This J-Pop assassin is all about the full frontal assault and you have a backstage pass to try her out for free.

Replacing Nigel in the free hero rotation* would be a tough act to follow for some, but Kira is a pro. Ready yourself for twin, custom SMGs, the Kitty Cannon, and a monstrous skill set that lets her buff the speed of allies reload and shield-up with every enemy she downs, kawaii!

http://i.imgur.com/ACuE7Y5.gif

Kira is the star of the show – and she wants everyone to know it so here are the 5 Bullets for Bossing Kira-Chan:

5 BULLETS FOR BOSSING KIRA-CHAN
1. Deploy Speed and Bounce Pads to hurl Kira-Chan into your enemy. The quicker, the better – Kira loves shock tactics
2. Mow foes down with the fully-automatic alt-fire on her standard weapons – the twin SMGs Hidari and Migi.
3. Utilise the two firing modes of her Kitty Cannon to litter the battlefield with deadly rocket and grenade kitties.
4. Build two of her unique Popstar Portals to warp across the map – but beware, the enemy can use them too.
5. Activate her J-Pop Star skill to turn the battlefield into a music video. This gives Kira unlimited ammo for its duration and nearby allies reload faster.

For a more detailed look at Kira-Chan check out her promotional video – fully endorsed by her agent.

*WAIT A SECOND, WHERE’S NIGEL GONE!?! 
Fret not, Longshott! Nigel is only taking a  nap by the fire.

If you liked the playstyle of  this big-game  hunter and want to snipe him  for yourself,  he’s still available to purchase via the in  game store.

Balance Changes
Yuri the Yeti
The cooldown for the “Avalanche” Active Ability has been reduced meaning it can be used more frequently.
From 100 to 90 seconds at level 0
From 90 to 60 seconds at levels 1 and 2
From 80 to 50 seconds at levels 3 and 4
From 70 to 40 seconds at levels 7 and 8
From 60 to 30 seconds at levels 9 and 10
O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi
The amount of healing granted by use of the “Vanish” Active Ability has been reduced.
From 25% to 20% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 0 to 3. 
From 50% to 40% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 4 to 6.
From 75% to 60% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 7 to 9.
From 100% to 80% of O.P.’s standard health at level 10.
The standard number of Ninja Stars that O.P. can carry has been reduced from 48 to 24.

If you want to discuss this and more, head on over to our Steam Discussion Forum

notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/steam-promo_Roly.jpg

Hey all,

Below are the main highlights of today's update.

Roly Poly Fat Fat 
This update brings a new Hero to Block N Load: Roly Poly Fat Fat!

The world’s cutest hamster. The world’s deadliest hamster ball. Roly Poly Fat Fat blasts onto the battlefield with her TankBall Cannons, Boosters, and Toxic Waste. Fully weaponised, she’s ready to roll. 

If you want to know more about Roly Poly Fat Fat, her weapons, abilities, and Blocks click here.

Perks 
We have just completed a review of all the perks in Block N Load and as a result our perks system has undergone a major re-balancing to make some pretty significant improvements.

The overall goal of the perks was to allow additional options in how Heroes are played through combining perks with Heroes and your personal play styles.  We also wanted to make sure that as you progress through tier 1, 2 and 3 of each perk they were clearly improvements in your specialization.  To this end we have decided to implement a flat negative for all tiers of a particular perk.  

This means it is clearly better to continue down the line of the perk and invest in higher levels, in all instances of use.  This has been done for all Offensive, Defensive and Hero Perks.

We have also normalized a lot of the numbers and done a balance pass on some of the perks to now take account of this new flat negative value.

Balancing Changes
A whole host of other balancing changes have been made including:

Cogwheel

HP of Mortar Blocks has been reduced from 1000 HP to 500 HP.  The damage Mortars do to themselves when firing has also been adjusted so they can still fire 10 times.

Yury the Yeti

The ammo pool for the Snowball primary weapon has been increased from 1 to 3.
The rate at which the SnowThrower regenerates ammunition when close to Snow, Ice, or an Ammo Crate has been increased.

Dream Genie

The aura from Ifrit’s Grudge alternate attack no longer affects friendly targets.  However, the final explosion when the orb hits anything will still damage friend and foe alike.

Doc Eliza

The time between using the Chem Grenade’s alternate fire and it detonating has been decreased from 3 to 1.5 seconds.

O.P ‘Juan’ Shinobi

When using his Katana alternate fire to teleport this now only produces smoke at the point he teleports to instead of creating a smoke bomb block model.


Improvements and Bug Fixes
A number of improvements have been made and bugs have also been squashed in this update.  These include additional messaging as you progress through the Bronze, Silver, Gold and Pro Leagues; more information about completing challenges; and improvements to the way players with high latency are displayed moving about the arena.

For the full patch notes please follow the link here.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 2.1.1210 (15/10/2015)
notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo_demo.jpg
Hey all,

Below are the main highlights for the latest Block N Load update.

Free Rotation
 Sarge Stone is being removed from the Free Rotation and replaced with Cogwheel, our stomping heavy metal robot.
Heroes
We saw on the forums that some players thought the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk was a touch on the powerful side.  We looked both at the kill rates, and the overall damage that it added, and we have now brought it more in line with the other Hero Perks.

We also noticed that even in newer players hands O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi (and to a lesser extent Sweet Science) were getting hit and damage rates higher than other Heroes in similar level of skilled players.  Looking at the data we realized that their current swing “arc” was way too generous and players could basically just spam the attack button and even if only an elbow of the enemy was in screen it would “hit”.  The reduction of the arc will have absolutely no impact on most players, but the “just attack all the time, don't worry you will hit” aspect is now reduced.

For the specific numbers and information on these changes please see the sections for O.P. and Sweet Science below..

O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi
 Effects of the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk have been slightly reduced.  The DPS inflicted by the Bleed effect when the Perk is equipped has been changed from 4 at level 1, 4.5 at level 2, and 5 at level 3 to 3.5 at level 1, 4 at level 2, and 4.5 at level 3.  The Bleed effect remains at 5 seconds in length.  
 The description of the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk has been changed to make the effects clearer.
 Arc of the Katana has been reduced from 60 degrees to 45 degrees.  This means it will no longer hit targets on the edges of the screen.
Sweet Science
 Arc of the Blitz Stance attack has been reduced from 60 degrees to 45 degrees.  This means it will no longer hit targets on the edges of the screen.
Sarge Stone
 The “Just a Scratch” Hero Perk no longer affects the rate at which Sarge's Passive Ability heals him and now only affects the maximum HP that his Passive Ability can heal up to.
Vander Graaf
 Out of ammunition audio will no longer trigger when switching to Ball Lightning with a partially filled clip and ammo pool.
Astarella
 The Sonic Drill tool no longer points sideways when the Hero is moving sideways with it equipped.
General Perks
 The description of the “Dig that Health” Defensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
 The description of the “Dig that Ammo” Offensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
 The “Greedy” Defensive Perk has had the amount of extra bricks earned from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.  The longer build times have also been changed from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.
 The “Killer Bricks” Defensive Perk has had the extra bricks for killing a Hero changed from 25% at level 2 and 30% at level 3 to 30% at level 2 and 40% at level 3.  The longer build times have also been changed from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.
 The name of the “Quick Fingers” Offensive Perk is now correctly capitalized.
Menus
Play
 A "First Win of the Day" bonus has been added. For the first match you win each day you will receive 100 extra Gold and, if you are in Bronze League or above, double the amount of League Points.
 The claxon sound effect when a match is found has been re-added to the pop-up for joining a match through short handed games.
Profile
 The last Hero in the "Your Heroes" tab is no longer partially hidden behind the “Buy More Heroes” button.
 When viewing a level 0 Hero in the “Your Heroes” tab the XP to reach level 1 is now correctly displayed.
 The "Blocks Built" section should now correctly update.
 Matches which were joined using the “Join Shorthanded Games” backfilling system should now be displayed as a neutral result in the “Match History” tab.
Shop
 Prices for the Featured Hero are now displayed in the correct order. 
 Hero Perks can now be viewed even if you do not own the Hero for them.
 The icon for Gold is now correctly greyed out on items when you do not have enough Gold for.
 The next level of a Perk becomes visible automatically when the previous level of it has been purchased.
 Clicking on a second weapon or ability in the "About" section of a Hero's information will now correctly de-select the first one that had been selected.
 When viewing skins for Heroes the button to purchase the Hero themselves will no longer be present under the preview image.  Heroes will only be available to purchase from the “Heroes” tab of the shop.
Custom Game
 The menu for joining Custom Games has been rebuilt so that the last game in the list cannot become obscured behind the buttons.
 Game names can no longer have their size or colour changed.
 The preview of the Custom Game settings such as build time and respawn time now correctly updates for players browsing the list of games.
 The arrow buttons to change a map are no longer visible to players browsing the list of matches.
 The "Start Game" button no longer becomes hidden behind your player level if you have previously visited the Shop.
 An asterisk (*) is displayed after the name of a game which has already been started.
 The join game button is replaced with one stating the game has already been started if the match cannot be joined.
Friends List
 Opening the Friends list when you have a large number of Block N Load or Steam friends no longer causes a significant pause.
 When removing a Block N Load friend from your friends list the confirmation message no longer stays open after confirming you wish to remove the friend.
 Friends who are online in Steam but not currently playing Block N Load should now be able to be invited to play again.
Messaging
 The correct reward text should now be displayed on the end of game fanfare when you reach Gold League.
 The message displayed on the end of match fanfare when a player has completed the match after joining it to fill in for a player that dropped out no longer stretches over the edges of the screen.
 Messaging on the end of match fanfare for when a challenge is completed should no longer overlap the edge of the screen in any language.
Results Screen
 Players are no longer incorrectly marked as offline when they leave the results screen at the end of a match.
The number of blocks built and destroyed are now displayed on the end of match results screen.
HUD
 Your own ping (latency) will now be displayed on the scoreboard if you activate it up during a match.
 Icons for your Hero’s current health and ammunition have been updated.
 The Hero tips displayed when playing with a low level Hero can now be seen when waiting to respawn as well.
League
 Players no longer gain League Points for losing a match whilst in Bronze League.
 Players who reach Pro League should now have this correctly displayed on their player card.
You can read the full patch notes here

notes.title: Game Update 1.4 is live!
notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/steam-promo_dream_genie.jpg

Not only does this update unleash the Lady Of The Lamp, Update 1.4 also brings changes to recommended blocks, hero balance shifts, new arenas, matchmaking alterations, Blockbuster Boost and much more.

Heroes
Now that we have fixed the issue which caused fire rates to be linked to frame rates, we have completed a pass on all Heroes bringing their damage up to where the “60 FPS” players were seeing it before the bug fix.  Heroes’ damage in relation to each other remains the same, but the overall damage-per-second average is up to 40 from 35 and so “seconds to death” has been slightly reduced for all Heroes to be in line with what was intended.

Dream Genie
Another new Hero is entering the Block N Load arenas!  Dream Genie has some very unique options available to her including being throwing blocks that she constructs so that they are built further away from her and an active ability that can turn enemy devices to your team for a short period of time.  

See the Dream Genie guide here for the full run down of her weapons and abilities.

Hero Balance
Astarella
 Recommended block loadout has been changed to Orbital Strike Beacon, Bricks, Glue, Bear Trap, Speed Block, and Bounce Pad.
 P.P.P. player and world damage has been increased from 5 to 6 per shot.
 Orbital Strike Beacon cost increase when placing multiple copies whilst one is still active has been reduced from 2000 to 1500 bricks.  
 Orbital Strike Beacon damage has been increased from 30 to 35. 
 Hit detection when aiming at Astarella’s stomach has been improved.

notes.title: Game Update 1.3 is Live!
notes.notes:
https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo2.jpg

Ablockalypse Mode
A new experimental mode named “Ablockalypse” has been added and will be available from 16:00 BST on Friday the 29th of May to 10:00 BST on Monday the 2nd of June.  Ablockalypse mode is crazy, fast, and great for new players or a short manic blast of fun for more experienced players.  It’s not meant to be balanced, it’s just meant to be crazy.  

Compared to the current other game modes:
 Damage to other Heroes is increased by 25%. 
 Damage to world and player placed blocks is increased by 100%.
 Build speed has been increased by 100% (decreasing the time taken to build Blocks).
 Costs of most blocks are reduced to half their normal values, with the exception of Crates, Sandbags, and Bricks which are free.
 The time to Recall to your main spawn point has been reduced to 5 seconds.
 Hero Switching is enabled regardless of player level.
 Cost of switching Heroes has been removed.
 Heroes' active ability cool-down times are reduced by 50%.
 The build phase length is set to 240 seconds (4 minutes).
Let us know what you think about Ablockalypse here

Sweet Science
The king of the ring has arrived.  Sweet Science is punch drunk, knockout happy, and he means business.  Dish out pounding blows with his fists, dash attack or pull enemy heroes towards him, set up gravity traps, disable enemy devices and heal yourself – when the bell rings Sweet Science will be coming at ya!  

For a full run down of Sweet Science check out our thread about him here

Gameplay
 Collision between Heroes has been improved to make them more polite and thus less likely to push each other to the sides (and more likely to stop when they collide).
 The mechanism for controlling the fire rate of weapons has been changed to make rates of fire more consistent.  This affected a number of weapon’s fire rates; the affected weapons have had to be re-balanced because of this.
 Blocks which are dropped on to Lava are now destroyed.
 Respawn times for Classic and Ranked matches have been updated.  These are now 15 seconds at the start of the match.  These then increase to 30 seconds from 15 minutes after the end of the build phase, 45 seconds from 30 minutes after the end of the build phase, and 60 seconds from 45 minutes after the end of build phase.
Heroes
Astarella
 P.P.P. attack time has been increased to 0.15 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
 Orbital Strike Beacon special block now has escalating costs.  The cost to build increases by 2000 Bricks for Orbital Strike Beacon you have placed which is still active.
 Orbital Strike Beacon special block has been increased from 27 to 30 per tick.

Sergeant ‘Sarge’ Stone
 M60 OMG attack time has been increased to 0.15 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.

‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally
 Globe Gun primary and alternate fire attack times have been increased to 0.66 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
 Chem Grenade gas clouds now last for 5 seconds instead of 10 seconds.
 Miasma Mine special block gas clouds now last for 5 seconds instead of 10.
 Miasma Mine special block gas cloud damage has been increased from 15 per second to 20 per second. 

Cogwheel
 Rotary Cannon primary and alternate fire attack times have been increased to 0.2 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
 The textures for the tool and weapons on Cogwheel’s Dwarven Warsuit skin have been improved to better match his body.

Anthony ‘Tony’ Turretto
 Tony’s Caulk Gun no longer applies the Tiki Head visual effect when a player runs through it. The “Slow” status effect is still applied.
 Rivet Gun damage has been reduced from 1.5 to 1.25 per pellet to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations. 
Lil’ Buddy turret special block have had their health increased from 100 to 120.

O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi
 The bomb produced when using the “Vanish” active ability can now be hit and damaged.
 The smoke produced by the Katana alternate attack is now visible to the enemy team again.

Blocks and Devices
 Glue Block no longer applies the Tiki Head visual effect when a player runs through it. The “Slow” status effect is still applied.
Performance
 Fire Trap debris has been optimised so that it has a reduced effect on game performance.
Menus
 Ablockalypse mode has been added to the list of options in the “Play” section.
 The Custom games option has been moved to the right in the “Play” section to accommodate the new Ablockalypse mode.
 The text describing the different game modes has been updated.
 Friendly mode has been re-named to “Classic”.
 The match history information displayed after searching for another player in the “Profile” section should now be correct.
 The icon to indicate you backfilled in to a game when looking at match history in the “Profile” section has had a hover-tip added.
 Players in the Graveyard will no longer be able to access Custom games.
Tutorial
 The Practise Grounds tutorial have been completely re-designed to show off how to perform different game-play mechanics and to provide clearer instructions and ending.
Spectator
 When using the Spectator mode to watch a Custom game the color of names in the kill feed should now correctly indicate which team they are on.
Audio
 When hit by multiple sources of the “Slow” status effect the audio for these will no longer stack on top of each other.
 Additional sound effects have been added to the buttons when inviting players to squads.
 Buttons in the “Play” menu now only play one sound effect at a time. 
 The sound effects played when moving through water now respond to whether you are sprinting or walking.
 Additional sound effects have been added to Astarella and O.P.’s idle animations.
 Sound effects have been added when clicking on and releasing the sliders in the settings menus.
 Hero voice commands and death voice over lines should no longer play at the same time as the fanfare screen at the end of a Match.
Options
 V-Sync is now switched off by default on all Master Graphics settings.
Arenas
 The Last Bastion and Fun Factory have been added to Classic and Custom modes.
 Shuko Style and Beach Base have been added to Ranked mode.
 Insandity, High and Low, and Pillard have been added to Ablockalypse mode.
 A lava plane has been added to Mount Olympus, Olympia, Block Keep, Shuko Style, Pipe Mania, Causeway, Blockageddon, and A Cut Above.  This makes it clearer that falling off of the side of these arenas will kill your Hero.
 The no-build zones at the default spawn points have been improved in Beach Base, Pipe Mania, and Mount Olympia.
 Block Keep has had the position of the floating platforms tweaked slightly to improve their accessibility.

notes.title: Game Update 1.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Yesterday we released an update that added a new hero and changed some core areas of the game including Base health. It fundamentally changed the length of games too far, making them incredibly short, and we’ve read all your concerns and taken another look at how much we changed across the game. 

We’ve now implemented the below changes into this latest update and this will revert some areas to pre-patch levels. Check out the full details below.

Balancing

Gameplay

Cube and Base health has been restored to pre-update health.
Respawn times have been updated. These now start at 10 seconds, becoming 15 seconds after 5 minutes, 30 seconds after 15 minutes, and then 45 seconds after 30 minutes.

Blocks

Caltrops health and damage have been restored to their pre-update state.
Orbital Strike Beacon damage to players and blocks has been reduced by 30% and we will review its mechanics in the short to medium term.

Blockbuster and Supply Drops

Supply drops come in every 5 minutes after the end of the build phase unless there is a Blockbuster drop.
Blockbuster drops come in at 15, 25, and 35 minutes and then every 5 minutes after that point.

Ranked Mode

Moving forward, we’ve decided that when bringing out any new hero they will not be immediately available in Ranked matches. This allows for final balance and testing with real players in other modes first. To this end Astarella has been removed from Ranked for a short period until we all are more happy with her.
 

......................................................................................................................................................

(14/05/2015)

Update 1.2 is here and it's packed full of content. In addition to Astarella, the first of our new heroes, and Ranked Mode, we've also added new arenas to the friendly rotation and made numerous balancing tweaks & fixes.

Leaving Beta we've found that matches are lasting significantly longer than they used to, and longer than intended.  As such a number of changes to balancing and gameplay mechanics have been made to address this.

Heroes have been given more control in the air.

We want Glue Blocks to be cool and worth taking as part of Heroes’ loadouts so we reworked them.

Similarly whilst Bear Traps worked pretty well they didn’t really feel like bear traps so they have been changed up a notch. 

All the heroes will take a little more time to breathe and consider what they say.

A record of full details for Update 1.2 can be found on our website
